title: Canonical internal-Hom comparison for derived direct image
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and derived internal Hom R\mathcal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the derived categories D(\mathcal O_X), D(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. For L,M\in D(\mathcal O_X), there is a canonical natural morphism $$Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,M)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(Rf_*L,Rf_*M).$$ It is the internal-Hom projection comparison induced by the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] and evaluation; no isomorphism assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Remark remark-projection-formula-for-internal-hom (used as the first arrow of duality.tex equation-sheafy-trace)

proof.text: The adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] supplies the unit and counit of Lf^* ⊣ Rf_*. The tensor-internal-Hom adjunction [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] supplies the evaluation morphism R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,M)\otimes^L L\to M corresponding to the identity of R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,M).

source.place: Remark remark-projection-formula-for-internal-hom, construction from the derived adjunction and evaluation

proof.text: Test against an arbitrary A in D(O_Y) and a map \alpha:A\to Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(L,M). By the adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general], \alpha corresponds to Lf^*A\to R\mathcal Hom_X(L,M), which by [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] gives an evaluation composite Lf^*A\otimes^L L\to M. The adjunction transposes a map A\otimes^L Rf_*L\to Rf_*M to a map Lf^*(A\otimes^L Rf_*L)\to M. Using [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product] to identify this source with Lf^*A\otimes^L Lf^*Rf_*L, compose 1\otimes the counit Lf^*Rf_*L\to L with the evaluation composite. This constructs naturally a map A\otimes^L Rf_*L\to Rf_*M for every \alpha, hence by Yoneda a canonical morphism Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(L,M)\to R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_*L,Rf_*M).

source.place: Remark remark-projection-formula-for-internal-hom, projection comparison induced by evaluation

proof.text: All arrows in the construction are the natural unit, counit, tensor comparison, and evaluation maps supplied by the cited adjunction and tensor-Hom statements. Their functoriality in L and M therefore makes the resulting morphism natural in both variables; no invertibility is asserted.
